developments_coords_ck.name: developments_coords_ck
developments_coords_ck.value: ("developments"."latitude" IS NULL) = ("developments"."longitude" IS NULL) AND ("developments"."latitude" IS NULL) = ("developments"."location_precision" IS NULL)

developments_lat_lng_range_ck.name: developments_lat_lng_range_ck
developments_lat_lng_range_ck.value: "developments"."latitude" IS NULL OR ("developments"."latitude" BETWEEN -90 AND 90 AND "developments"."longitude" BETWEEN -180 AND 180)

developments_size_range_ck.name: developments_size_range_ck
developments_size_range_ck.value: "developments"."unit_size_min" IS NULL OR "developments"."unit_size_max" IS NULL OR "developments"."unit_size_min" <= "developments"."unit_size_max"

developments_price_ck.name: developments_price_ck
developments_price_ck.value:
("developments"."price_mode" = 'on_request' AND "developments"."price_amount" IS NULL AND "developments"."price_currency" IS NULL)
        OR ("developments"."price_mode" IN ('fixed','from','per_sqm_from') AND "developments"."price_amount" IS NOT NULL AND "developments"."price_amount" > 0 AND "developments"."price_currency" IS NOT NULL AND "developments"."price_currency" IN ('ETB','USD'))

inquiries_contact_ck.name: inquiries_contact_ck
inquiries_contact_ck.value: "inquiries"."email" IS NOT NULL OR "inquiries"."phone" IS NOT NULL

properties_size_ck.name: properties_size_ck
properties_size_ck.value:
("properties"."size_sqm" IS NULL OR "properties"."size_sqm" > 0)
        AND ("properties"."size_min_sqm" IS NULL OR "properties"."size_min_sqm" > 0)
        AND ("properties"."size_min_sqm" IS NULL OR "properties"."size_max_sqm" IS NULL OR "properties"."size_min_sqm" <= "properties"."size_max_sqm")

properties_price_ck.name: properties_price_ck
properties_price_ck.value:
("properties"."price_mode" = 'on_request' AND "properties"."price_amount" IS NULL AND "properties"."price_currency" IS NULL)
        OR ("properties"."price_mode" IN ('fixed','from','per_sqm_from') AND "properties"."price_amount" IS NOT NULL AND "properties"."price_amount" > 0 AND "properties"."price_currency" IS NOT NULL AND "properties"."price_currency" IN ('ETB','USD'))
